Dead Man’s Crew brings the crew ashore for a night of wild celebrations, cascading wins, and plenty of treasure-fuelled chaos. Between adventures, the crew has taken over the tavern — and with growing Wild Scatter multipliers, powerful Crew Features, and a maximum win of 10,000x your bet, the party can get seriously rewarding.
